description: Exact cell-count arithmetic and an abstract colored-incidence construction for the hypothetical identical-terminal four-path row. The run independently brute-forces small valid simple-graph decompositions and checks the symbolic classification through exponent 12 and every permitted cell count.
scope_note: This is an exact arithmetic verifier, not a graph census, SAT model, proof-assistant verification, or minimum-degree-three saturation search. The alternating ladder is an abstract colored-core family, not a live Type-T residual: ancestor pole forcing excludes X_x=y,X_y=x.

symbolic_classification.k=1: FORCED iff m+n is a forbidden power of two; otherwise UNIVERSALLY_SAFE

proved_reduction: Complete abstract four-path incidence arithmetic admits the infinite even-k alternating-ladder family L_{rho,k,t}; this demonstrates that arithmetic alone does not bound colored cores.
structural_supersession: The canonical Type-T application is empty: in T2 both x,y are cubic, while pole forcing requires X_x=X_y=z_0. Thus the identical-terminal assumptions X_x=y,X_y=x and every associated saturation/Q extension are impossible.
